The Legal Support
In addition to the codes previously quoted, there are a number of non-permissive federal, state and local laws which will apply to the environmental aspects of development on the Westmoreland Resources coal lease tracts.
Federal Legislation - The following public Laws, U. S. Codes, and Federal Regulations are applicable to coal leasing and industrial development on the Ceded Area and Crow Indian Reservation.
(1) United States Statutes at Large: 
(a) Act of June 8, 1906 (34 Stat. 225) An act for the preservation of American Antiquities.
(b) Historic Sites Act of 1935.
(c) Act of July 9, 1956 (70 Stat. 498) Federal Water Pollution Control Act.
(d) National Historic Preservation Act.
(e) Act of July 20, 1961 (75 Stat. 204; P.L. 87-88)
Federal Water Pollution Act Amendments of 1961.
(f) Act of October 2, 1965 (79 Stat. 903; P.L. 89-234)
Water Quality Act of 1965.
(g) Act of 1969 (83 Stat. 742; P.L. 91-173)  Coal Mine Health and Safety Act.
(h) Act of January 1, 1970 (83 Stat. 1073)  Declaration of National Environmental Policy.
